learning_outcomes.text: Developing skills to grasp the fundamental elements of reasoning, to classify between different levels of abstraction, to maintain attention continuity and connect ideas.
Acquiring notions of convergence, limit, series, continuity, partial derivative, differentiability, Taylor expansion, local extremum.
Developing calculation skills, the ability to efficiently use specialized bibliography.
Applying fundamental mathematical knowledge to solve problems specific to the Mechanical Engineering field.

syllabus_topics: Numerical series. Convergence criteria. Approximate calculation of sums.
Partial derivatives. Differentiability. Function approximation. Extrema. Implicit functions.
Approximate calculation of sums of convergent series.
Limits and continuity of functions of several variables.
Implicit functions. Extrema of implicit functions.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is composed of a written exam (50%) and two applied tests (50%). To pass the discipline, the student must obtain a minimum grade of 5 for both the evaluation test (exam) and the ongoing activity.
